title: GRADE Task Definition
description: Schema for a single GRADE benchmark task. Tasks are the atomic evaluation unit: one question, one fixture pack, one rubric.

task_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for the task. Convention: '<track_abbrev>-<pack_abbrev>-NNN', e.g. 'T1-OPS-001'.

track.description: Benchmark track number (1–5). (1) Grounded Retrieval & Computation, (2) Program Snapshot & Trend, (3) Operational Coaching & Recommendations, (4) Equity & Subgroup Interpretation, (5) Program Effectiveness & Research Reasoning.

title.description: Short, human-readable title for the task (displayed in reports and the leaderboard explorer).

user_prompt.description: The exact natural-language prompt sent to the model under evaluation. Must be self-contained when combined with the pack fixture files.

task_type.description: Coarse categorization of the analytical operation required.

allowed_inputs.description: Fixture file names (relative to the pack root) the model is permitted to use when answering. Governs which data is 'in scope' for grounding checks.

items.description: Relative fixture file path, e.g. 'sessions.csv' or 'program_context.json'.

gold_facts.description: Atomic, verifiable factual claims that a correct answer must assert or be consistent with. Each fact is a ground-truth statement computable from the fixture. The C1 (Grounding Accuracy) scorer checks these.

gold_insights.description: Higher-level analytical conclusions that a strong answer should reach. These are evaluated by the C3 (Insight Quality) scorer and may reference multiple gold_facts.

required_limitations.description: Limitations, caveats, or uncertainty statements the model MUST acknowledge. Absence is penalized by the C3 (Calibration & Limitation Handling) scorer.

forbidden_claims.description: Claims the model must NOT make (hallucinations, causal over-reach, etc.). Presence is penalized by the C1 scorer.

rubric.description: Per-dimension scoring rubric for this task. Dimensions align with the project-level scoring weights.

reference_answer_outline.description: Optional: a prose sketch of what an ideal answer looks like. Used during task authoring and human review. NOT exposed to the model under evaluation.

GoldFact.description: A single verifiable ground-truth claim derived from fixture data.

fact_id.description: Identifier unique within the task, e.g. 'F1', 'F2'.

claim.description: The exact claim that must be verifiable from the fixture data.

source_files.description: Fixture files that contain the data supporting this fact.

numeric_value.description: If the claim is numeric, the expected value for automated comparison.

tolerance.description: Allowed absolute deviation for numeric comparisons (e.g. rounding). Null means exact match.

Rubric.description: Per-dimension scoring weights and guidance for a single task. Weights must sum to 1.0.

grounding_accuracy.description: Weight and guidance for Grounding Accuracy (project default: 0.35). Measures whether asserted facts are verifiable from the fixture data.

insight_quality.description: Weight and guidance for Insight Quality (project default: 0.20). Measures analytical depth and usefulness.

evidence_linkage.description: Weight and guidance for Evidence Linkage (project default: 0.15). Measures whether claims are explicitly tied to source data.

calibration_limitation_handling.description: Weight and guidance for Calibration & Limitation Handling (project default: 0.15). Measures appropriate uncertainty and caveat disclosure.

consistency.description: Weight and guidance for Consistency (project default: 0.10). Measured across 5 repeated runs per model×task pair.

structure_usability.description: Weight and guidance for Structure & Usability (project default: 0.05). Measures practitioner-facing format quality.

RubricDimension.description: Scoring weight and optional scorer guidance for one rubric dimension.

weight.description: Fractional weight of this dimension in the task's total score. All six dimension weights must sum to 1.0.

guidance.description: Optional scorer/reviewer guidance text specific to this task and dimension.
